name: Spark of the Baking Incident
description: Fire salts instead of flour. The kitchen exploded. Elder Caelum's eyebrows never grew back. This spell makes a sudden burst of flame, not a controlled one but a passionate, enthusiastic one. She still bakes him a cake every year. She buys it now.

params.message: A shower of sparks erupts from her hands. One candle ignites. The curtains are fine. Probably.
The room brightens and warms rapidly.
For a moment you smell burnt sugar and regret.
